changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwavailabilitytemplate AS SELECT a.id, a.facility_id, a.department_id, a.template_name, a.template_type, a.resource_id, a.template_color, a.status, a.version_no, a.copy_from_template_id, a.parent_template_id, a.duration_minutes, a.default_buffer_before_minutes, a.default_buffer_after_minutes, a.parallel_capacity_value, a.default_service_id, a.number_of_resources_expected, a.require_practitioner, a.default_practitioner_id, a.require_billing, a.require_pre_assessment, a.allow_patient_portal_booking, a.require_confirmation, a.financial_details, a.working_days, a.is_active, a.created_by, a.created_date, a.last_modified_by, a.last_modified_date, a.allow_walk_in_booking FROM public.availability_template a;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwavailabilitytemplate TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON report.availability_template FROM report_user;
